name: RPG Shooter: Starwish
source:
RPG Shooter: Starwish is a unique blend of a shooter, rpg, visual novel and dating sim rolled into one!

[From [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/]official site[/url]]

You play as a space pirate named Deuce, trying to find out the reason the Federation is acting so aggressively lately.
translation:
《RPG Shooter: Starwish》将射击游戏、角色扮演游戏、视觉小说和恋爱模拟巧妙融合为一体！

[译自 [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/]官方网站[/url]]

玩家扮演名叫杜斯的太空海盗，试图查明联邦近来为何表现得如此咄咄逼人。
